source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, Chipotle employed 130,301 people worldwide and 1,233 contract workers. Of our employees, 127,116 worked in the United States

payroll.label: annual total compensation of our median employee for 2025

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: This resulted in identification of a median employee with annual total compensation for 2025 of $17,446, which is the compensation for an hourly part-time employee who works roughly 24 hours per week at one of our restaurants in Texas

notes: Employees: year-end head count from the FY2025 10-K, excluding 1,233 contract workers. Payroll: the income statement's 'Labor' line ($2,991.7 million in 2025) is restaurant labor only, a component of restaurant operating costs; salaries in general and administrative expenses are not included and no company-wide staff-cost total is disclosed, so it is not used. The proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 (same year as the head count) is used instead; Chipotle says its median employee is an hourly part-time restaurant worker (about 24 hours a week), so the figure is not a full-time wage.
